predictions.guard_summary: No validation for duplicate keys in dictionary definition; Python dictionary behavior overwrites previous values
predictions.risk_pattern: Duplicate dictionary key causes silent overwrite of tag mapping, potentially leading to incorrect tag name resolution during EXIF metadata processing
predictions.context_summary: The TAGS dictionary maps EXIF tag numbers to human-readable names. The duplicate key 0x1001 appears twice: first as "RelatedImageLength" (line 70) and then as "RelatedImageWidth" (line 71). Python dictionaries overwrite previous values when duplicate keys are encountered.

Whether this affects production code or only debug output
